context:
Systematic verification of all launch criteria. No shortcuts - test every
page, every browser, every deployment path. Fix issues found during acceptance
before marking launch complete.
description:
Final launch gate for the Phase 1 results explorer. This TODO verifies that
all launch criteria are met, the seed corpus is complete and correct, the
explorer works end-to-end in production, and the feature is ready for public
announcement.

Launch criteria (from strategy memo):
1. Seed corpus has sufficient depth for the dynamic comparison tool: each
   included benchmark has ≥3 comparable platforms at the same scale factor
2. Compare view is the primary entry point and works end-to-end: select
   benchmark/scale/platforms → query-level timing breakdown → shareable URL
3. All explorer pages render correctly with real data
4. DuckDB-WASM filtering works in Chrome, Firefox, Safari
5. GitHub Pages deployment succeeds end-to-end from CI
6. Explorer is navigable from the existing site header/nav
7. Brand ownership decision is resolved and reflected in domain/hosting/identity

anti_patterns.dont: accept corpus depth below the ≥3-platforms threshold by shipping placeholder data
anti_patterns.why: the compare view is the primary deliverable and requires depth

anti_patterns.dont: mark launch complete before all 7 criteria are verified
anti_patterns.why: a partial launch is harder to fix than a delayed launch

anti_patterns.dont: merge the explorer into main without verifying existing benchbox.dev pages still work
anti_patterns.why: a broken docs or landing deploy is a regression even if the explorer is perfect

anti_patterns.dont: skip cross-browser testing on the assumption that Chrome results cover Firefox and Safari

preserves.behavior: All seed corpus results must be accessible and renderable in the explorer
Existing benchbox.dev pages (landing, docs, blog) must be verified as unaffected

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import json, collections; m = json.load(open('results-explorer/public/data/manifest.json')); cohorts = collections.defaultdict(set); [cohorts[(r['benchmark'], str(r.get('scale_factor','')))].add(r['platform']) for r in m['results']]; print(f'{len(m["results"])} results across {len(cohorts)} cohorts'); [print(f'  {k}: {len(v)} platforms ({sorted(v)})') for k,v in sorted(cohorts.items())]; assert all(len(v) >= 3 for v in cohorts.values()), f'Cohorts with <3 platforms: {dict((k,len(v)) for k,v in cohorts.items() if len(v)<3)}'"
verifications.description: Seed corpus meets depth-per-benchmark criterion (≥3 platforms per benchmark×scale cohort)
verifications.expected: All benchmark×scale cohorts have ≥3 comparable platforms

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run build && test -f dist/index.html && test -f dist/tpch/index.html && ls dist/r/*/index.html | wc -l
verifications.description: Full site build succeeds (landing + docs + blog + explorer)
verifications.expected: Build succeeds; index, benchmark, and result detail pages present

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm run build
echo 'Manual: verify Chrome, Firefox, Safari per w2 checklist'
